smiles: string

// Find the most similar molecules from the training set using task-aware embeddings. // Task name for task-aware retrieval (e.g., 'AMES', 'DILI').

k?: number
}) => any;

smiles: string

// The arithmetic expression to evaluate.
expression: string
}) => any;

// Compute electronic properties: HOMO/LUMO energies and gap, dipole moment, electrophilicity index. type get_electronic_properties = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
